title: Create reference images first (e.g., character and key props/location) and use…
content:
Create reference images first (e.g., character and key props/location) and use them as IMAGE REFERENCES with explicit “only lock” instructions to keep the same face/vehicle/street consistent across the whole clip.

Specify the capture format and realism cues in the prompt (e.g., RAW HOME PHONE VIDEO, 3:4 vertical, continuous 30-second clip, amateur handheld micro-shake, pinch-zooms, focus hunting, auto-exposure pumping, overcast daylight) to force a believable “found footage” look.

Write a second prompt that uses the generated clip as a reference and instruct Seedance to continue from the last frame to extend the scene while preserving continuity (e.g., use the last 10s as ref; Use the [video] as reference and continue from the last frame).

Use a timestamped TIMELINE (0–8s, 8–14s, etc.) with explicit camera actions (zoom in/out, operator moves closer/backing up) to control pacing and shot behavior within a single continuous take.

Define AUDIO explicitly (diegetic sources, when music starts, what sounds are present, and “No extra score / No cinematic sound design”) to steer Seedance toward naturalistic sound.

es.content:
---
Crea primero imágenes de referencia (por ejemplo, del personaje y de los props/ubicación clave) y úsalas como IMAGE REFERENCES con instrucciones explícitas de “only lock” para mantener la misma cara/vehículo/calle consistentes en todo el clip.

Especifica el formato de captura y las señales de realismo en el prompt (por ejemplo, RAW HOME PHONE VIDEO, 3:4 vertical, continuous 30-second clip, amateur handheld micro-shake, pinch-zooms, focus hunting, auto-exposure pumping, overcast daylight) para forzar un aspecto creíble de “found footage”.

Escribe un segundo prompt que use el clip generado como referencia e instruya a Seedance a continuar desde el último frame para extender la escena mientras preserva la continuidad (por ejemplo, use the last 10s as ref; Use the [video] as reference and continue from the last frame).

Usa una TIMELINE con marcas de tiempo (0–8s, 8–14s, etc.) y acciones de cámara explícitas (zoom in/out, operator moves closer/backing up) para controlar el ritmo y el comportamiento de la toma dentro de un único plano secuencia continuo.

Define el AUDIO explícitamente (fuentes diegéticas, cuándo empieza la música, qué sonidos están presentes y “No extra score / No cinematic sound design”) para orientar a Seedance hacia un sonido naturalista.
---

fr.content:
Créez d’abord des images de référence (par exemple, le personnage et les accessoires/lieux clés) et utilisez-les comme IMAGE REFERENCES avec des instructions explicites de type “only lock” afin de conserver le même visage/véhicule/rue de manière cohérente sur l’ensemble du clip.

Précisez le format de capture et les indices de réalisme dans le prompt (par exemple, RAW HOME PHONE VIDEO, 3:4 vertical, continuous 30-second clip, amateur handheld micro-shake, pinch-zooms, focus hunting, auto-exposure pumping, overcast daylight) pour imposer un rendu crédible de type “found footage”.

Rédigez un deuxième prompt qui utilise le clip généré comme référence et demande à Seedance de continuer à partir de la dernière image pour prolonger la scène tout en préservant la continuité (par exemple, use the last 10s as ref; Use the [video] as reference and continue from the last frame).

Utilisez une TIMELINE horodatée (0–8s, 8–14s, etc.) avec des actions de caméra explicites (zoom in/out, operator moves closer/backing up) pour contrôler le rythme et le comportement du plan dans une seule prise continue.

Définissez explicitement l’AUDIO (sources diégétiques, moment où la musique commence, sons présents, et “No extra score / No cinematic sound design”) afin d’orienter Seedance vers un son naturaliste.

ja.content:
---
まず参照画像を作成し（例：キャラクターや主要な小物／ロケーション）、それらを IMAGE REFERENCES として使用し、同じ顔／車両／通りがクリップ全体を通して一貫するように、明示的な「only lock」指示を入れます。

プロンプトにはキャプチャ形式とリアリズムの手がかりを明記します（例：RAW HOME PHONE VIDEO、3:4 vertical、continuous 30-second clip、amateur handheld micro-shake、pinch-zooms、focus hunting、auto-exposure pumping、overcast daylight）。これにより、説得力のある「found footage」風の見た目を強制できます。

生成したクリップを参照として使い、最後のフレームから続けてシーンを延長するよう Seedance に指示する2つ目のプロンプトを書きます。連続性を保つため、最後の10秒を参照にする、Use the [video] as reference and continue from the last frame、などの指示を入れます。

タイムスタンプ付きの TIMELINE（0–8s、8–14s など）を使い、明示的なカメラアクション（zoom in/out、operator moves closer/backing up など）を記述して、1回の連続したテイク内でのテンポとショットの動きを制御します。

AUDIO は明確に定義します（diegetic sources、音楽が始まるタイミング、どんな音があるか、そして “No extra score / No cinematic sound design”）。これにより、Seedance を自然主義的なサウンドへ誘導できます。
---

ko.content:
---
먼저 레퍼런스 이미지를 생성하고(예: 캐릭터와 핵심 소품/장소), 이를 IMAGE REFERENCES로 사용하면서 “only lock” 지시를 명확히 넣어 전체 클립에서 같은 얼굴/차량/거리 풍경이 일관되게 유지되도록 합니다.

프롬프트에 촬영 형식과 리얼리즘 단서를 명시하세요(예: RAW HOME PHONE VIDEO, 3:4 vertical, continuous 30-second clip, amateur handheld micro-shake, pinch-zooms, focus hunting, auto-exposure pumping, overcast daylight). 이렇게 하면 믿을 만한 “found footage” 느낌을 강제할 수 있습니다.

생성된 클립을 레퍼런스로 사용하는 두 번째 프롬프트를 작성해, Seedance가 마지막 프레임부터 이어서 장면을 확장하되 연속성을 유지하도록 지시합니다(예: use the last 10s as ref; Use the [video] as reference and continue from the last frame).

타임스탬프가 표시된 TIMELINE(0–8s, 8–14s 등)과 명시적인 카메라 동작(zoom in/out, operator moves closer/backing up)을 사용해, 하나의 연속된 테이크 안에서 페이싱과 샷의 움직임을 제어하세요.

AUDIO를 명확하게 정의하세요(다이제틱 소스, 음악이 시작되는 시점, 어떤 소리가 있는지, 그리고 “No extra score / No cinematic sound design”). 이렇게 하면 Seedance가 자연주의적인 사운드로 가도록 유도할 수 있습니다.
---

pt.content:
Crie primeiro imagens de referência (por exemplo, personagem e props/localização principais) e use-as como IMAGE REFERENCES com instruções explícitas de “only lock” para manter o mesmo rosto/veículo/rua consistentes em todo o clipe.

Especifique o formato de captura e os sinais de realismo no prompt (por exemplo, RAW HOME PHONE VIDEO, 3:4 vertical, continuous 30-second clip, amateur handheld micro-shake, pinch-zooms, focus hunting, auto-exposure pumping, overcast daylight) para forçar um visual crível de “found footage”.

Escreva um segundo prompt que use o clipe gerado como referência e instrua o Seedance a continuar a partir do último frame para estender a cena enquanto preserva a continuidade (por exemplo, use os últimos 10s como ref; Use the [video] as reference and continue from the last frame).

Use uma TIMELINE com timestamp (0–8s, 8–14s, etc.) e ações de câmera explícitas (zoom in/out, operador se aproximando/afastando) para controlar o ritmo e o comportamento da tomada dentro de um único take contínuo.

Defina o AUDIO explicitamente (fontes diegéticas, quando a música começa, quais sons estão presentes e “No extra score / No cinematic sound design”) para orientar o Seedance em direção a um som naturalista.

zh.content:
先创建参考图像（例如角色和关键道具/地点），并将它们作为 IMAGE REFERENCES 使用，同时加入明确的“only lock”指令，以确保整个片段中相同的脸/车辆/街道保持一致。

在 prompt 中明确指定拍摄格式和真实感线索（例如 RAW HOME PHONE VIDEO、3:4 vertical、continuous 30-second clip、amateur handheld micro-shake、pinch-zooms、focus hunting、auto-exposure pumping、overcast daylight），以强制呈现可信的“found footage”效果。

再写一个第二个 prompt，使用生成的片段作为参考，并指示 Seedance 从最后一帧继续，延展场景同时保持连续性（例如，use the last 10s as ref；Use the [video] as reference and continue from the last frame）。

使用带时间戳的 TIMELINE（0–8s、8–14s 等），并加入明确的镜头动作（zoom in/out、operator moves closer/backing up），以控制单个连续长镜头中的节奏和画面行为。

明确定义 AUDIO（diegetic sources、音乐何时开始、有哪些声音，以及 “No extra score / No cinematic sound design”），以引导 Seedance 生成更自然写实的声音。
